body_md: Treat both this Inspector and every selected database as untrusted until inspected. Internal hashes establish consistency only; they do not authenticate a publisher.
title: Keep the trust boundary explicit

body_md: Use Python's standard library to extract the hash-checked standalone host to a new cache path. Review that executable before running it.
title: Extract the standalone host

body_md: Verify this Inspector before launching it. Stop on any structural, asset-integrity, endpoint, or application-check failure.
title: Verify the Inspector

body_md: After a deliberate trust decision, launch the extracted Python host. It binds to 127.0.0.1; the Inspector itself has no native client dependency and makes no network requests.
title: Launch locally

body_md: Choose a local SQLite file in the browser. The pinned in-memory SQLite WASM engine runs fixed catalogue queries only. Target HTML, JavaScript, commands, prompts, runbooks, and declared check SQL remain inert and target bytes are never written.
title: Inspect without executing the target

body_md: Stop only the matching capsule-specific host instead of killing arbitrary Python processes.
title: Stop the matching host
